newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks hit fresh high after opening jump.
newsitem.headline: French stocks hit fresh high after opening jump.

text.p: French shares opened more than one percent higher and set a fresh record high at 2,631.89 before slipping slightly on profit taking.
Wall Street's record close, a firm dollar and steady bond markets underpinned share prices.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was up 23.86 points or 0.92 percent at 2,623.19 at 0926 GMT, while the CAC-40 futures contract was up 27 points at 2,632.

Generale des Eaux was some four percent higher on the back of news it had been selected as industrial partner by railroad SNCF to operate its telecommunications network. This deal strengthens Generale des Eaux' Cegetel telecoms unit ahead of full competition with France Telecom in 1998.
Bouygues dropped by over five percent at 552 francs on the same deal. Bouygues had last week been rumoured to be the winner of the contract, with its German partner VEBA and Italy's STET.
Alcatel Alsthom was down 0.34 percent at 583 francs on news ITT was seeking to sell its five percent stake.
